Loved the food and service! Worth a visit
Jul 2025 • Couples
Four of us randomly tried this restaurant as our first option was full. We were so glad we ate here! We left the dinner up to our lovely waiter, but we specified we only wanted vietnamese vegetarian, seafood, and chicken options. He didn't disappoint as we ended up with cockle and tomato soup, a lightly spiced poached chicken, a side of roasted spiced carp perfectly cooked, a tofu "morning glory" dish, and some rice. He also suggested a 2 litre keg of beer, which was from Hoi An. The decor is a quirky "jungle" setting and the staff are excellent. We loved the place, and will be back again next time we are in Saigon.

Good food and great service
Mar 2023 • Couples
Three of us were strolling through Saigon looking for somewhere to have supper. Landed on this restaurant. Very popular with Vietnamese families, couples and groups of workers. We were looked after by a delightfully extravagant waiter called Bao Bao. His English was excellent and he guided us through the extensive menu making helpful suggestions as to what we might enjoy. The food arrived very quickly and when it did it was very good. We chose a fried pork dish, a fish cooked in ginger and a fried rice dish and a boiled rice. This was plenty for three of us.
